# Click Decoded

> Click Decoded is a B2B digital growth agency based in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India, operating since 2014 under Aharnish Infotech Private Limited (CIN U72200MP2014PTC033341). It provides SEO, Google & Meta Ads, web development, WhatsApp and n8n AI automation, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and white-label fulfilment for other agencies. Retainers start at ₹25,000 per month with a 30-day exit notice.

Key facts:
- Headquarters: Amrit Complex, Raisen Road, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462023, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 94070 00101 · Email: hello@clickdecoded.com
- Serves: Bhopal, Indore, Madhya Pradesh and clients across India (remote)
- Founders / directors: Mukteshwar Sharma, Bhagvendra Pratap Singh
- Pricing: Starter ₹25K/mo (1 service), Growth ₹55K/mo (3 services), Enterprise ₹1.2L/mo

## Core services
- [SEO Services](https://www.clickdecoded.com/seo-services.html): technical audits, content strategy, link building
- [Local SEO](https://www.clickdecoded.com/local-seo.html): Google Maps and Business Profile ranking
- [Programmatic SEO](https://www.clickdecoded.com/programmatic-seo.html): scalable template pages
- [Google Ads](https://www.clickdecoded.com/google-ads.html) and [Meta Ads](https://www.clickdecoded.com/meta-ads.html) management
- [Web Development](https://www.clickdecoded.com/web-development.html), [WordPress](https://www.clickdecoded.com/wordpress-development.html), [E-commerce](https://www.clickdecoded.com/ecommerce-development.html)
- [AI Automation](https://www.clickdecoded.com/ai-automation.html), [WhatsApp Automation](https://www.clickdecoded.com/whatsapp-automation.html), [n8n Workflows](https://www.clickdecoded.com/workflow-automation.html), [AI Chatbots](https://www.clickdecoded.com/ai-chatbot-development.html)
- [Generative Engine Optimization](https://www.clickdecoded.com/generative-engine-optimization.html), [Answer Engine Optimization](https://www.clickdecoded.com/answer-engine-optimization.html), [LLM Optimization](https://www.clickdecoded.com/ai-search-optimization.html)
